_source: Transcribed from the supplied printed Fate Check page: the Fate Check Modifiers table, the Fate Check Answers table, and the rules text around them.
notes: Rolling 2d10 to meet or exceed a target number of 11. Rolling 11 or more is a Yes, rolling under 11 is a No.
The roll is modified by the Odds and the Chaos Factor, both read off the same Roll Modifier column.
A little faster than the Fate Chart and it matches the same odds fairly closely, but the Chaos Factor has more influence on Exceptional results.
